text:
Mercedes-Benz Malaysia has announced yet another first of its kind today, the first-ever, fully-electric EQC now available in our country as the EQC400 AMG Line, starting from an 
estimated RM390,000
. The Mercedes-Benz 
EQS450+
 was also launched today, from 
RM698,888
, alongside the 
EQB350 4MATIC
 from an estimated RM330,000.
The EQS450+ may be the grandest EQ model introduced today, but the EQC is actually the first fully electric production vehicle by Mercedes-Benz.
The EQC400 indicates its electric nature upon arrival with blue lighting on its headlights equipped with Multibeam LED technology. At the rear, the tailgate is struck through with a taillight strip that stretches from one side to the other. Like the EQS, the EQC400 weighs close to 2.5-tonnes as well – probably heavier if it weren’t for the modular-designed battery pack weighing 655 kg.
EXTERIOR
20-inch AMG multi-spoke light-alloy wheel
AMG Line bodykit
Multibeam LED headlights with Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus
The EQC400 gets its power from two electric motors, one in the front and rear, to drive all four wheels. The electric motors get their power from an 80 kWh battery, capable of returning up to 437 km of electric driving range.
With 11kW AC charging, it takes approximately 7.5 hours to fully charge the EQC although with 110 kW DC fast charging, it’ll take just 40 minutes to get the EQC up to 80% charged.
PERFORMANCE
Max Power: 408 hp
Max Torque: 760 Nm
0 to 100 km/h: 5.1 seconds
Top Speed: 180 km/h
Consumption: 21.3 – 25 kWh/100km
INTERIOR
Inside the cabin is furnished by items that may seem familiar to you; such as the steering wheel design, centre console and air-con panel seen in current Mercedes-Benz vehicles but it stops there.
You get a horseshoe-like dashboard that extends into the textured door panels. Take a closer look and you’d also notice that the air vent design is different from current Mercedes-Benz vehicles.
Nappa leather sport steering with shift paddles
Dual 10.25-inch displays, Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
Man-made Nappa leather dashboard
Head up display
Burmester Surround Sound System
Wireless charging
2x USB-C
Electronically adjustable front seats
SAFETY
Driving Assistance Package
Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus
Parking Package with 360-degree view
Active Parking Assist

reference_summary: Mercedes-Benz Malaysia telah melancarkan tiga kenderaan elektrik (EV) baharu di negara ini: EQC400 AMG Line, EQS450+ dan EQB350 4MATIC. EQC400 ialah kenderaan pengeluaran elektrik sepenuhnya pertama oleh Mercedes-Benz dan berharga daripada anggaran RM390,000. Ia dilengkapi dengan roda aloi ringan berbilang jejari AMG 20-inci, kit badan AMG Line, lampu depan LED Berbilang Pancaran, dan Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus. EQC400 dikuasakan oleh dua motor elektrik, satu di hadapan dan belakang, menghasilkan 408 hp dan 760 Nm tork. Ia boleh memecut dari 0-100 km/j dalam 5.1 saat dan mempunyai kelajuan tertinggi 180 km/j. Bateri 80 kWj EV menyediakan sehingga 437 km jarak pemanduan elektrik, dan ia boleh dicas dengan pengecasan pantas 11kW AC atau 110 kW DC. EQC400 menampilkan bahagian dalam yang luas dengan papan pemuka seperti ladam kuda dan paparan dwi 10.25 inci, stereng sukan kulit Nappa, papan pemuka kulit Nappa buatan manusia dan Sistem Bunyi Surround Burmester. Ciri keselamatan termasuk Pakej Bantuan Memandu, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus, Pakej Tempat Letak Kereta dengan pemandangan 360 darjah dan Bantuan Parking Aktif.
